rules.title: TrailRunCoach：CPU 連續一週尖峰超過 2 核

model.query:
import "date"
import "experimental"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")
// the last 7 complete days (Taipei): each day's peak = the largest 5-minute mean
stop = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
start = experimental.subDuration(d: 7d, from: stop)
from(bucket: "<INFLUX_BUCKET>")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r._field == "usage_percent" and r.container_name == "trailruncoach" and r.cpu == "cpu-total")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 100.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> reduce(identity: {days: 0, lowest_peak: 1000000.0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({days: accumulator.days + 1,
                                      lowest_peak: if r._value < accumulator.lowest_peak then r._value else accumulator.lowest_peak}))
  // fewer than 7 days of data (Telegraf just started): 0, never an alert
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r.days >= 7 then r.lowest_peak else 0.0}))

annotations.summary: trailruncoach 容器最近 7 天每天的 CPU 尖峰都超過 2 核
annotations.description: 7 天裡最低的那天尖峰是 {{ printf "%.2f" $values.B.Value }} 核。該升級主機了（SP-321：Hetzner CX33，約 NT$345／月）。

rules.title: TrailRunCoach：記憶體連續一週尖峰超過 2.5 GiB

model.query:
import "date"
import "experimental"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")
// the last 7 complete days (Taipei): each day's peak = the largest 5-minute mean
stop = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
start = experimental.subDuration(d: 7d, from: stop)
from(bucket: "<INFLUX_BUCKET>")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and r.container_name == "trailruncoach" and (r._field == "usage_percent" or r._field == "limit"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.usage_percent * float(v: r.limit) / 100.0 / 1073741824.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> reduce(identity: {days: 0, lowest_peak: 1000000.0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({days: accumulator.days + 1,
                                      lowest_peak: if r._value < accumulator.lowest_peak then r._value else accumulator.lowest_peak}))
  // fewer than 7 days of data (Telegraf just started): 0, never an alert
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r.days >= 7 then r.lowest_peak else 0.0}))

annotations.summary: trailruncoach 容器最近 7 天每天的記憶體尖峰都超過 2.5 GiB
annotations.description: 7 天裡最低的那天尖峰是 {{ printf "%.2f" $values.B.Value }} GiB。該升級主機了（SP-321：Hetzner CX33，約 NT$345／月）。

  |> group()
  |> last()
